scripts.dev: bun run --cwd packages/web build && bun run --cwd packages/cli dev -- ../../README.md
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/web build && bun run --cwd packages/cli build && bun run --cwd packages/server build
scripts.install:cli: bun run --cwd packages/cli build && npm install -g ./packages/cli
scripts.install:full: bun run install:cli && bun run --cwd packages/server build && npm install -g ./packages/server
